world: World: Hidden Shrine Valley, a Japanese mountain shrine valley at night under a veiled moon; dark mossy greens, old grey stone, cool calm colours.
ground: a dark mossy forest floor: short dense grass and moss, tiny clover, scattered small pebbles and a few tiny pink sakura petals.
low: a damp shaded hollow: dark wet soil and moss, tiny ferns, small wet pebbles, a few small dark puddles; darker and bluer than the grass around it.
high: a crisp detailed moonlit meadow: dense short soft-green grass blades drawn clearly, small clover patches and tiny white and pale blue flowers, evenly spread; brighter and fresher green than a dark forest floor.
trail: a worn packed-earth footpath: compacted brown-grey earth with fine gravel, small flat pebbles and a few fallen petals, no stepping stones.
cliff: a low earthen cliff: a grassy overhanging lip with a few short hanging roots and moss along the top edge; below it, layered grey-brown rock and packed earth with patches of moss.
